title: Jungle Scene 9 — Rainforest Actions and Directions
purpose: Combining action verbs with one-step and two-step listening tasks.

sentenceModels: The frog is on the leaf.
First point to the elephant, then point to the toucan.

adultSupport.focus: Support listening with two-step instructions and short action descriptions.
expansionPrompts: First point to the elephant, then point to the frog.
Find the striped animal and then the bird with the big beak.

visualAudit: One elephant on the left spraying water with its trunk.
One tiger on the right walking beside the stream.
One frog sitting on a leaf near the bottom centre.
One parrot perched on the upper-left.
One toucan perched on the upper-right.
